method: Core/platform pass. Anchored on WinMain (sole caller of CRT entry 0x67bbe0) and the CET-named utyGameSystemsPreInit/Init, then walked their call order against Relic's 2003 source (GoK root ad1bb82, Win32/utility.c:3782-4440, main.c:3285-3480) and the utyStartedBits set/clear pairs in utyGameSystemsShutdown to name the startup/shutdown chain; identified task.c (ORIG x86 context-switch scheduler, 0x34-byte taskdata, named taskStart), memory.c (cookie allocator near the 0xfa7babc0 immediates), file.c/bigfile.c/BitIO.c, statscript.c, Strings.c, key.c, demo.c, Debug.c, debugwnd.c, ddraw.cpp, linkedlist.c, Queue.c, FEFlow.c and SaveGame.c by error strings, call graph and ORIG function order; globals come from decompiled DAT_ uses and from a .data scan of 12-byte scriptEntry rows {name,cb,&var} matched to ORIG makeEntry/explicit table rows (high) or, for Cataclysm-only rows in makeEntry-style tables, the row's own identifier string (medium). Data addresses are Ghidra DEFAULT labels (DAT_/PTR_/s_ tokens in decompiled.c) or strings.csv entries; symbols.csv lists only non-default symbols. ORIG = /tmp/claude-1000/hw1orig/orig/src (GoK ad1bb82); hw1_equivalent cites HomeworldSDL only when the name exists there.

Sample: random.seed(7), stratified 25 high + 4 medium + 1 low. DROPPED 0x00521a40 'SEloadscripts': the body is the stream/music half of HW1 speechevent.c:401 speechEventInit. It calls soundstreamquery and returns -1 when buffersize==0, allocates the speech buffers, loads Music4Cat.wxh and checks 'Music data file does not match lookup table', and inlines the SEinitdelayEQ band loop. SEloadscripts (only 2 scriptSetStruct calls) and the speechqueue init loop are also inlined. It returns 0/-1, not void. Its caller 0x521d50 calls 0x5217f0 first and then this function. How the sample was checked: the 13 scriptEntry-row data entries were re-read from the exe bytes. Each 12-byte row {name, cb, &var} matched, and each variable's initial value equals the HW1 default (for example pieMaxMoveVertical 15000.0, ROLLCAREENHI 100.0, CHECK_BOUNTIES_RATE 127, AUTOSTABILIZE_FRAME_KICK_IN 8). MUSIC_MINBATTLE_VOL is in .bss, matching its uninitialised definition. Each of the 15 function entries was compared line by line with the ORIG source. The key translators line up by table order: German 0x882268, French 0x882668, Spanish 0x882a68, Italian 0x882e68. Out-of-sample notes, with nothing dropped for them: (a) 0x005631f0 renames CET's patch-site-derived 'InitWindow' to WinMain. This is justified, since it is the sole callee of CRT entry. (b) Proposed memFree 0x004ae130 duplicates the name that CET's IMPORTED memFree already has at 0x00673080 (body __free_dbg(ptr,1), i.e. CRT free). The applier must rename the CET one or there will be two memFree symbols. (c) The 877 data addresses are Ghidra DEFAULT DAT_ labels, not symbols.csv rows, which deviates from the contract wording. Sampled ones are real variable starts. (d) The citations depend on /tmp/claude-1000/hw1orig/orig/src (GoK ad1bb82). It still existed at audit time (orig/src and gok present) but is outside the project.
